messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] quantile regression

On Wed, 2017-07-19 at 04:08 -0700, MHelbich wrote:
> It seems that there was no response on this old posting...
> Is there an example to run a qunatile regression in INLA?
> Any hint is appreciated.

the quantile `likelihood' based on the skew laplace, is removed from the code: because
1.
it does not give 'correct' bayesian inference as its not a likelihood and contain
and arbitrary scaling [there is a nice paper about this in International Statistical Review,
I think, a few years ago], and
2. it does not play well with the laplace approximations since the
local second derivative is zero.

there is always the option of doing parametric quantile regression...

H
